newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker vs dollar.

text.p: Large import payments by state-owned banks further tightened the liquidity of the U.S. currency in interbank market on Wednesday, forcing the Bangladesh taka to end weaker at 43.7600/7700 to the dollar, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted at 43.7500/7800 per dollar during early trade, and dealers said there had been very few transactions. The interbank call money rates closed at 8.0 to 9.0 percent against previous 9.0-11.0 percent, dealers said. - Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
